from.title: ReCiPe2016: a harmonised life cycle impact assessment method at midpoint and endpoint level
from.version: IJLCA22:138–147(2017); online2016-12-12; acquired10-page original article PDF; distinct from RIVM2016-0104 and2017v1.1 report
from.question: How do this source’s indicators, model boundaries, temporal/spatial assumptions and value choices constrain interpretation?
from.argumentSummary: 中点与终点是这份方法的互补指标层次，取决于路径、保护对象和单位。情景同时组织时间范围和证据取舍；地区覆盖、物种损失和缺失路径限制解释。毒性部分采用USES-LCA2.0与USEtox物质数据，不等于采用USEtox模型。

passages.locator: Title page; original publication dates and article type
limits: 2016 online date and 2017 issue year differ. The PDF retains 2016 publisher copyright; the publisher page separately records a 2020 Open Choice license correction.

Method authors describe complementary indicators; this is not independent validation or a universal superiority ranking. Resource endpoint currency is a modeled extra extraction cost, not an automatic weighting of human health against ecosystems.

passages.locator: §2.2 Model selection criteria; §2.3 Scenario analysis; Fig.1 and caption
limits: 20/100/1000-or-infinite are scenario conventions, not a uniform time window for all categories or a statement of current scientific consensus. Authors explicitly decline a superiority claim for models chosen for in-house feasibility. Fig.1 dotted fossil-resource path verified in page image.

Historical ReCiPe implementation uses USES-LCA 2.0 with USEtox chemical data; it is not the USEtox model. Authors practical reasons are scoped to this publication and not assertions about later releases.
